title: Sprint lifecycle CLI smoke test (chub_sprint.py)
summary: Run the full scripts/chub_sprint.py lifecycle (plan → start → done → review → retro) against a scratch story, confirming that board status changes, chub annotations, and board rebuild all fire correctly.
description:
scripts/chub_sprint.py wraps board status transitions with chub annotation writes, providing a single CLI interface for the sprint loop. This story verifies the end-to-end flow without touching production stories:

1. Create a scratch story `WF-scratch.json` in project-management/board/stories/ with status 'To Do' (not committed, used only for this test).
2. Run: `python scripts/chub_sprint.py plan --stories WF-scratch --goal 'smoke test'`
   → Confirms chub annotation on sprint-workflow is written.
3. Run: `python scripts/chub_sprint.py start --story WF-scratch`
   → Confirms WF-scratch.json status = 'In Progress' and board rebuilt.
4. Run: `python scripts/chub_sprint.py done --story WF-scratch --note 'smoke test complete' --annotate-gotcha 'chub_sprint.py smoke-tested OK'`
   → Confirms WF-scratch.json status = 'Done', chub annotation on sdk written.
5. Run: `python scripts/chub_sprint.py review`
   → Confirms WF-scratch appears in Done section and annotations are listed.
6. Run: `python scripts/chub_sprint.py retro --note 'smoke test passed' --rate up`
   → Confirms retro annotation written and chub feedback command fires.
7. Delete WF-scratch.json, rebuild board.

Acceptance: all six commands exit 0; WF-scratch status progresses correctly through the lifecycle; chub annotations are written and visible via `chub annotate --list`.
